verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Qapita serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the product, and many docs items come from that file, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Its content appears to be product and marketing summaries rather than deep agent-oriented technical documentation. Missing for 10: substantive agent-oriented technical/API docs within or linked from llms.txt, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usefulness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
